value.rationale: The number f(4) is not an arbitrary slice: it is exactly the natural extremal invariant introduced and studied in both current papers, at the four-prime box, a finite case not settled by asymptotic large-N bounds. Determining f(4)=144 (density 9/16), with upper and lower finite certificates and nontrivial 242-vertex connected component, provides a reproducible exact benchmark for attempts to sharpen the quantitative theory. This does not claim a general N theorem.
